arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the sides that brought the case claim the Fifth Amendment imposes an explicit duty to pay money.
Texas asserts its constitution is more protective than the federal one.
Justice Gorsuch noted the Fifth Amendment may not create an independent cause of action.
Justice Barrett questioned how the ratifiers viewed the Fifth Amendment as supplying a cause of action.
